name: Muriel Viejo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, yellow and green with a narrow yellow stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Muriel Viejo (a sun, a tree and waves on blue, and a wolf and a hive on green).
history: Municipal flag of Muriel Viejo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Muriel Viejo arms — sun, tree and waves on blue, wolf and hive on green
